description: Every FRITZ!Box feature the shell scripts have, plus a local database that remembers what your router forgets.

tools.name: dect_list
tools.description: List the registered DECT handsets. Optional: query. Returns array of Handset.

tools.name: hosts_list
tools.description: List every device the router knows, online and offline. Optional: query. Returns array of Host.

params.name: query
params.description: FRITZ!OS data-path expression selecting the device fields to return

tools.name: query_run
tools.description: Run an arbitrary FRITZ!OS data-path expression and print the raw JSON result. Required: result. Returns the QueryResult.

params.name: result
params.description: FRITZ!OS data-path expression, for example wlan:settings/ssid

tools.name: tam_list
tools.description: List the configured answering machines and whether each is active. Optional: query. Returns array of Tam.

tools.name: wlan_info
tools.description: Read the primary wireless network name and whether the access point is enabled. Optional: ssid (default: wlan:settings/ssid), enabled (default: wlan:settings/ap_enabled). Returns the WlanInfo.

params.name: ssid
params.description: Data-path expression for the network name

params.name: enabled
params.description: Data-path expression for the access-point enabled flag
